name: ACAudit
description: Meteor addon with features I wanted for auditing own servers/ACs on 1.2.11, decided to open source

modules.name: Module Example
modules.description: An example module that highlights the center of the world.

modules.name: Low Hop Fly
modules.description: Hovers with onGround=true. Tests server-side ground validation.

modules.name: Omni Sprint
modules.description: Forces sprint in all directions. Tests sprint vs movement-vector cross-check.

modules.name: Velocity Exploit
modules.description: Cancels server velocity packets. Tests knockback validation.

modules.name: Packet Step
modules.description: Spoofs Y position upward without a jump arc. Tests path-continuity validation.

modules.name: High Jump
modules.description: Multiplies jump take-off velocity. Tests vertical-speed / jump-height detection.

modules.name: Air Jump
modules.description: Jump again while airborne. Tests fly / air-movement detection.

modules.name: Bhop
modules.description: Auto-jumps with no landing delay. Tests jump-delay enforcement and ground-state tracking.

modules.name: Speed
modules.description: Boosts horizontal velocity in the input direction. Tests horizontal-speed detection.

modules.name: Instant Step
modules.description: Instantly steps up a full block via a jump-arc packet sequence. Tests step-height / vertical-teleport checks.

modules.name: Stealth Fly
modules.description: Fly variants that stay under threshold checks. Probes AC blind spots (per-tick delta, ground flag, gravity sim).

modules.name: Blink
modules.description: Holds outbound packets then flushes them in a burst (lag switch). Tests packet-cadence / silence detection.

modules.name: Ping Spoof
modules.description: Delays KeepAlive responses to fake high ping. Tests whether latency checks can be gamed by the client.

modules.name: No Fall
modules.description: Spoofs onGround while falling to cancel fall damage. Tests server-side fall-damage computation.

modules.name: Reset VL
modules.description: Performs clean filler hops to farm legal ticks. Tests whether your violation-level decay is gameable.

modules.name: Anti Setback
modules.description: Rejects / spoofs server position-corrections. Tests whether AC enforcement survives a non-cooperative client. COMBINE WITH speed/phase — alone it does nothing; together it tests whether a dropped correction = a bypass.

modules.name: Timer
modules.description: Speeds up the client tick clock. Tests wall-clock rate limiting vs. per-tick checks.

modules.name: No Slow
modules.description: Removes the item-use movement slowdown. Tests server-side speed validation against item-use state.

modules.name: Vehicle Move
modules.description: Flies/speeds the vehicle you're riding via VehicleMoveC2SPacket. Tests vehicle-movement authority.

modules.name: Elytra Exploit
modules.description: Overrides glide velocity to a fixed speed (firework-boost spoof). Tests elytra speed authority.

modules.name: Riptide Launch
modules.description: Imparts a riptide-magnitude launch with no water/rain context. Tests riptide precondition validation.

modules.name: Phase
modules.description: Walks reported position forward through blocks then snaps across. Tests move-continuity / collision validation.

modules.name: Momentum Break
modules.description: Reports a move sequence with legal per-step speed but impossible acceleration between steps. Tests whether the AC models acceleration, not just speed.

modules.name: Ground State Forge
modules.description: Reports onGround transitions inconsistent with the Y-trajectory (fake landing, no-approach, flicker). Tests whether the AC derives ground state instead of trusting the client bit.

modules.name: Jump Arc Forge
modules.description: Reports a jump with correct peak height but physically wrong arc shape/timing/symmetry. Tests whether the AC validates the whole trajectory against gravity.

modules.name: Model Drift
modules.description: Adds a tiny constant sub-threshold bias to every reported position. Tests whether the AC bounds cumulative drift or only per-tick error.

modules.name: Block Update Race
modules.description: Fires a block place/break and a move on the same tick. Tests whether movement validates against a consistent world snapshot.

modules.name: Chunk Edge Move
modules.description: Oscillates across the nearest chunk seam with borderline steps. Tests for a validation gap at chunk boundaries.

modules.name: Legit Velocity Launder
modules.description: Latches a legitimate velocity source and retains it past natural decay. Tests whether the AC models velocity decay, not just its source.

modules.name: Physics Anomaly
modules.description: Reports trajectories valid under a borrowed physics model (gravity/step/swim/slow-fall/levitation/vehicle/scaffold) the player isn't actually in. Tests state-gated physics validation.

modules.name: Transaction Timing
modules.description: Delays transaction Pong replies to inflate the latency a transaction-based AC measures. Tests transaction-clock compensation (unlike ping-spoof's keepalive path).

modules.name: State Machine Fuzz
modules.description: Cycles ground/air transitions faster than the jump cooldown allows, each transition individually valid. Tests transition-rate limiting.

modules.name: Packet Order Skew
modules.description: Reorders the tick's move and action packets (action-first / interleaved). Tests whether the AC assumes a fixed per-tick packet order.

modules.name: Combat State Probe
modules.description: Sends one attack while in an impossible movement state (jump apex / fast move / sprint desync). Tests combat↔movement state sharing.

modules.name: Uncertainty Farm
modules.description: Waits for a real uncertainty source (push/slime/ice), then spends a small illegal delta inside the borrowed tolerance window. Tests whether tolerance is source-scoped or pools into slack.

modules.name: Offset Boundary
modules.description: Maps the exact horizontal-speed offset the AC tolerates in the player's current state. An instrument, not a bypass.

modules.name: Input Launder
modules.description: Reports a delta shaped like a legal input the player isn't pressing (sprint while idle, jump while grounded). Tests input-consistency vs input-union validation.

modules.name: Compensation Boundary
modules.description: Holds a fixed illegal speed delta and ramps injected transaction latency until the compensation window absorbs it. Reports the window boundary.

modules.name: Sim Gap Suite
modules.description: Reports special-case block physics (powder snow / bubble column / cobweb / honey / edge-landing / scaffold) without the block present. Tests block-gated physics validation.

modules.name: Entity Push Model
modules.description: Spends a small illegal delta only while a real entity crowd is pushing you. Tests whether push uncertainty is bounded by the actual entities present.

modules.name: Reach World State Race
modules.description: Fires one attack on the exact tick the crosshair target's position/velocity update lands. Tests whether reach uses live vs compensated target position.

modules.name: Setback Interference
modules.description: Provokes a setback then fires a second illegal hop inside the pending-setback window. Tests whether checks use the stale pre-setback baseline.

modules.name: Timer Balance Soak
modules.description: Inflates flying-packet rate by a sub-1% sustained drift over a long session. Tests timer-balance accumulator integrity over time.

modules.name: Accumulator Soak
modules.description: Emits one identical violation at a fixed cadence all session and tracks whether the correction rate drifts over time. VL/accumulator integrity instrument.

modules.name: FPCover
modules.description: Adds a minimal illegal delta while you perform a documented false-positive scenario. Tests whether FP tolerance also passes a cheat.

modules.name: Source Attribution
modules.description: Holds a fixed speed and reports the real velocity-source state. Run with and without a source to test attribution.

modules.name: Low TPSReach
modules.description: Attacks the nearest target beyond normal reach and records distance vs TPS. Tests whether reach leniency scales with server lag.

modules.name: Baseline Poison
modules.description: Behaves cleanly to establish a baseline, then drifts a speed delta in as a continuation. Probes the profile/heuristic AC class (not deterministic-physics ACs).

modules.name: Vehicle Sim Gap
modules.description: Probes vehicle-specific prediction gaps (ice overspeed, passenger desync). Tests whether vehicle movement gets the same authority as player movement.

modules.name: Respawn Model Reset
modules.description: Fires an illegal hop immediately after respawn to test whether the AC resets its movement model or lets pre-death state leak post-respawn.

modules.name: Flight Claim
modules.description: Asserts flying=true via UpdatePlayerAbilities and moves up. Tests whether the server/AC trusts the client-reported flight ability bit.

modules.name: Input Toggle Desync
modules.description: Floods sprint/sneak/input toggles faster than the server reconciles. Tests whether the AC's pose/sprint state stays consistent.

modules.name: False Positive Audit
modules.description: Inverse test: measures whether the AC setbacks/flags LEGITIMATE play (optionally under legal latency jitter / lag-spike catch-up). For AC tuning.

modules.name: Slot Exploit
modules.description: Sends OOB / negative slot click packets. Tests bounds checking and stale-revision rejection.

modules.name: Slot Sync Probe
modules.description: Drives container syncId/slot/button/revision to illegal boundary values to map which fields the platform normalizes vs passes to plugins raw.

modules.name: Event Order Probe
modules.description: Fires the same effect via different Bukkit events and synthetic event orders (close-before-open, click-after-close). Tests plugin event coverage.

modules.name: Vault Value Probe
modules.description: Fuzzes the two-account transfer (/pay) with amounts that break the withdraw/deposit invariant. Tests Vault transfer atomicity and conservation of money.

modules.name: Sign Content Fuzz
modules.description: Sends fuzzed sign-line text (dangerous numeric/format values) to the sign you are editing. Tests sign-shop/economy plugins' sign-text parsing.

modules.name: Interaction Flood
modules.description: Floods container clicks per tick. Tests race-condition dupe windows and rate limiting.

modules.name: Drop Pickup Dupe
modules.description: THROW+PICKUP on same slot with revision=0. Tests stale-revision rejection across armor/offhand/hotbar slots.

modules.name: Container Exploit
modules.description: Tests post-close clicks and cycling wrong syncIds (±1, 0, 32767).

modules.name: Econ Fuzz
modules.description: Fuzzes an economy command with edge-case numbers that reach the plugin's parser (sci-notation, locale-comma, Unicode digits, double precision-loss). Tests value parsing, not the server char filter. COMBINE WITH interaction-flood to test parsing under event-queue pressure.

modules.name: Sell Race
modules.description: Fires an economy command as a same-tick burst (TOCTOU). Tests atomicity of sell/payout vs. item removal.

modules.name: Auction Race
modules.description: Spams valid clicks on one GUI slot in a single tick. Tests concurrency handling of buy/claim/list buttons.

modules.name: Gui Clicker
modules.description: Hold a key to spam-click the slot under your cursor in any open GUI. Tests plugin-GUI click concurrency.

modules.name: Gui Action Rotator
modules.description: Fires every GUI action type (left/right/shift/swap/clone/double/throw/outside) at one slot, same-tick or rotating, with a click sweep and response-latency measurement.

modules.name: Manual Click
modules.description: Hand-crafts a ClickSlotC2SPacket (syncId/revision/slot/button/action) and fires it. Bring-your-own-payload interaction tester.

modules.name: Two Window Race
modules.description: Clicks a container slot and a player-inventory slot in the same tick. Tests cross-inventory locking in trade/sell GUIs.

modules.name: Window Swap Race
modules.description: Captures the real previous syncId across a GUI switch and clicks both the live and stale window in one tick. Tests Paper InventoryView desync.

modules.name: Close Click
modules.description: Sends a click and the close packet in the same tick. Tests synchronous, atomic window teardown.

modules.name: Slot Overlay
modules.description: Renders each slot's network id (plus syncId/revision and the hovered item) over the open GUI. Maps container/plugin layouts for the dupe modules.

modules.name: Shulker Race
modules.description: Quick-moves a shulker's contents and breaks the block in one sequence. Tests open-container vs block-removal atomicity.

modules.name: Gui Desync
modules.description: Holds container click/close packets then bursts them (auto-grab optional). Tests GUI TOCTOU / snapshot locking.

modules.name: Auto Race On Open
modules.description: On any GUI open, bursts clicks at all slots before the menu locks. Tests open-handshake locking. Fully automated.

modules.name: Inventory Sweep
modules.description: Sends the chosen action at every slot in the open GUI. Tests uniform per-slot validation. No slot config.

modules.name: Offhand Swap Spam
modules.description: Spams offhand swaps (no GUI needed). Tests rate-limiting and atomicity of the offhand item-movement path.

modules.name: Shift Click Race
modules.description: Same-tick QUICK_MOVE burst across a slot range. Tests QUICK_MOVE destination-search atomicity. COMBINE WITH a lag inducer (packet-spammer) to widen the race window.

modules.name: Drag Split Race
modules.description: Starts a right-click drag then closes the container mid-drag. Tests drag-state cleanup on window close.

modules.name: Phantom Container
modules.description: Closes a container then immediately sends click packets on the same syncId. Tests post-close click rejection.

modules.name: Death Inventory Race
modules.description: Floods inventory ops when health is critically low. Tests death-processing vs. inventory-mutation atomicity.

modules.name: Chest Shop Race
modules.description: Spams shop block-use and container clicks simultaneously. Tests shop buy-trigger vs. click atomicity.

modules.name: Hopper Race
modules.description: Floods clicks on hopper slots while the hopper transfer tick runs. Tests hopper transfer vs. player-click mutex.

modules.name: Relog Dupe
modules.description: Performs an action then force-disconnects N ticks later. Tests save-on-quit ordering vs. in-flight transactions.

modules.name: Ender Chest Desync
modules.description: Grabs ender chest contents then force-disconnects. Tests atomic+flushed profile save and session fencing.

modules.name: Crafter Dupe
modules.description: Floods Crafter grid slot-toggle clicks while it crafts. Tests craft-vs-toggle atomicity (run with a redstone clock).

modules.name: Craft Grid Race
modules.description: Same-tick QUICK_MOVE burst on the crafting result slot. Tests result-vs-grid-consumption atomicity.

modules.name: Bundle Dupe
modules.description: Bundle component desync via a stale-revision click burst OR a BundleItemSelected select-burst (modern mechanism). Tests bundle content/count reconciliation.

modules.name: Portal Dupe
modules.description: Fires an action on an interval and logs dimension changes. Tests transaction handoff across dimension boundaries.

modules.name: Anvil Grindstone Race
modules.description: Same-tick QUICK_MOVE burst on the anvil/grindstone output slot. Tests output-vs-input+XP atomicity.

modules.name: Station Result Race
modules.description: Snipes a single output-grab on a work-station result slot (furnace/brewing/grindstone/anvil/loom/stonecutter/enchant/villager). Tests result-vs-input atomicity.

modules.name: Beacon Effect Race
modules.description: Snipes beacon effect-confirm packets in the payment-consume window. Tests payment-vs-effect atomicity.

modules.name: Death Drop Race
modules.description: Snipes one inventory op at the exact death tick. Tests death drop-generation vs. inventory-mutation atomicity.

modules.name: Revision Abuse
modules.description: Probes revision overflow / stale-context / forward-jump / syncId-mismatch. Tests whether revision is validated against the right container.

modules.name: Creative Dupe
modules.description: Materialises items via the creative inventory packet (bypasses InventoryClickEvent). Tests whether the creative path is validated like normal clicks.

modules.name: Event Bypass Probe
modules.description: Moves items via offhand-swap / creative-set / drop (paths that skip InventoryClickEvent). Tests whether plugin validation covers non-click paths.

modules.name: Spectator Transition
modules.description: Snipes an inventory click during a gamemode flip (operator-triggered). Tests atomicity of the spectator interaction gate.

modules.name: Trade Shop Overlap
modules.description: Races a container click and a merchant-trade selection in one tick (two transaction contexts). Tests cross-context item locking.

modules.name: Crate Result Race
modules.description: On crate GUI open, grabs the result slot throughout the spin animation. Tests grab-before-animation-validation. Fully automated.

modules.name: Enchant Result Race
modules.description: Swaps the item in an enchant table and clicks an enchant button in the same tick. Tests whether enchant options are re-validated against the current item.

modules.name: GUIClose Anomaly
modules.description: Exercises abnormal GUI close paths (silent close, double close, wrong syncId, close-during-transaction, close+reopen, menu-resurrection) to find dangling plugin sessions.

modules.name: Merchant Trade Fuzz
modules.description: Fuzzes villager/custom-merchant trade selection: out-of-range indices, and select+take restock races (economy dupe on custom-merchant shops).

modules.name: XCarry Probe
modules.description: Parks an item in an ephemeral slot (craft grid/result/armor/offhand/cursor) then closes the container, to test whether the server clears non-storage slots on close.

modules.name: Vehicle Container Dupe
modules.description: Pulls an item from a chest-boat/minecart-chest container then force-disconnects, racing the entity-vs-player save split. Tests vehicle-inventory dupe protection.

modules.name: Payload Flood
modules.description: Alternates oversized book and sign packets. Stress-tests server payload size limits. WARNING: high server impact; can kick/lag even locally.

modules.name: Nbt Bomb
modules.description: Sends pathological NBT (deep compound / deep list / wide fan-out) via creative slot packet. Requires creative mode. WARNING: can hard-crash or kick even a local server.

modules.name: Block Interaction Spam
modules.description: Floods block interact packets. Tests plugin event hook overhead and rate limiting.

modules.name: Arm Animation Flood
modules.description: Floods swing packets. Tests broadcast queue saturation.

modules.name: Sell Command Fuzz
modules.description: Cycles edge-case quantities through /sell. Tests integer parsing and injection hardening.

modules.name: Position Crash
modules.description: Floods position packets with extreme, infinite, NaN, or finite-but-nasty coordinates. Tests movement bounds + finiteness checking (absorbs extreme-velocity + nan-position).

modules.name: Completion Crash
modules.description: Tab-completion parser overflow (nested JSON) or special-char partials at a plugin command. Tests the server parser and plugin tab-complete handlers.

modules.name: Recipe Advancement Fuzz
modules.description: Fuzzes CraftRequest (garbage recipe ids) and AdvancementTab (garbage tabs). Tests low-attention recipe/advancement C2S handling.

modules.name: Unloaded Chunk Interact
modules.description: Sends block actions and block-entity NBT queries at far/unloaded coordinates. Tests whether the server validates chunk-loaded-for-player before acting.

modules.name: Container Crash
modules.description: Spams container-open packets at every chest/shulker in range. Press Escape to stop.

modules.name: Creative Crash
modules.description: Sends creative-set-slot packets with a block-entity-data payload spawning fireballs. Requires creative mode.

modules.name: Entity Crash
modules.description: Spams vehicle move/paddle packets while riding an entity. Tests vehicle position validation.

modules.name: Error Crash
modules.description: Sends click-slot packets with garbage fields OR a valid-but-impossible field combination. Tests parameter validation ordering.

modules.name: Interact Crash
modules.description: Sends block/item interaction packets at random or out-of-bounds positions.

modules.name: Lectern Crash
modules.description: Sends a QUICK_MOVE click on a lectern's virtual slot when it opens. Tests lectern slot handling.

modules.name: Message Lagger
modules.description: Sends dense Unicode chat that lags recipients' CLIENT renderers (not the server). Tests chat rate/length limits + high-plane Unicode stripping. Own server only.

modules.name: Movement Crash
modules.description: Floods jittered moves OR walks an almost-legal impossible speed. Tests rate limiting and inter-tick continuity. WARNING: heavy load; run crash modules LAST.

modules.name: Packet Spammer
modules.description: Spams onGround + swing packets to test raw inbound packet rate limiting. WARNING: heavy packet load; can trip the packet-limiter / lag a local server.

modules.name: Sequence Crash
modules.description: Sends interactions with an invalid sequence number (-1). Mainly affects non-Paper servers.

modules.name: Snbt Depth
modules.description: Sends commands with deeply-nested SNBT (compound / list / wide) in a selector. Tests command-parser recursion/size limits.

modules.name: Structure String Flood
modules.description: Floods structure/jigsaw/command-block packets with oversized or unicode-edge string fields. Tests string length + content validation.

modules.name: Beacon Crash
modules.description: Floods beacon-effect update packets with no beacon open. Tests beacon update gating + rate limiting.

modules.name: Passenger Loop
modules.description: Spams mount interactions to provoke a passenger cycle. Tests passenger-chain cycle guard / traversal bounds.

modules.name: Chunk Border Stress
modules.description: Ping-pongs reported position across a chunk boundary (CHUNK_EDGE) or the entity-tracking range (TRACKING_RANGE). Tests chunk-load + entity-tracker debouncing under crossing pressure.

modules.name: Portal Spam
modules.description: Spams portal block-use packets + position packets into the portal. Tests portal transition pipeline under rapid re-initiation.

modules.name: Entity Spam
modules.description: Spams attack/interact + arm-swing packets on the crosshair (or latched) entity. Tests interaction rate-limiting, cooldown, and removal-tick races.

modules.name: Mount Crash
modules.description: Rapid mount/dismount packet spam. Tests mount state-machine atomicity and transition rate limiting.

modules.name: Channel Flood
modules.description: Floods metadata packets, or a custom plugin-channel payload with a malformed body. Tests per-type rate limiting + custom-payload decode bounds.

modules.name: Packet Order Chaos
modules.description: Sends packets in causally impossible sequences. Tests server-side precondition validation and causal-order enforcement.

modules.name: Fast Mine
modules.description: Instant-breaks the looked-at block via START/STOP packets. Tests server-side break-TIME validation (AC test — not a crash/lag vector).

modules.name: Fast Use
modules.description: Triggers item use faster than vanilla allows. Tests server-side use/cooldown enforcement (AC test — not a crash/lag vector).

modules.name: Fast Attack
modules.description: Attacks the looked-at entity many times per tick. Tests server-side attack-cooldown / hit-rate enforcement (AC test — not a crash/lag vector).

modules.name: Nbt Query Flood
modules.description: Floods block/entity NBT-query packets (cheap to send, expensive to serialize). Tests query rate-limiting + permission ordering.

modules.name: Chunk Ack Spoof
modules.description: Reports a dishonest huge chunk-throughput credit. Tests the chunk-send flow-control clamp.

modules.name: Respawn Race
modules.description: Floods PERFORM_RESPAWN while alive / mid-transition. Tests respawn-state gating and transition atomicity.

modules.name: Stats Request Flood
modules.description: Floods REQUEST_STATS (server re-serializes the full stat map each time). Tests stat-request rate-limiting.

modules.name: Resource Pack Desync
modules.description: Sends resource-pack statuses for unoffered packs / in illegal order. Tests pack-id validation + handshake state machine.

modules.name: Spectator Tp Edge
modules.description: Sends spectator-teleport to unknown/self/cross-world UUIDs. Tests target resolution null-checks + spectator gating.

modules.name: Transition Race
modules.description: Replays inventory/interaction packets during the respawn/dimension-change window. Tests transition-state validation.

modules.name: Worldgen Crawler
modules.description: Drifts position outward at legal speed into ungenerated terrain to force synchronous chunk generation. Paper-specific, non-op TPS killer that never trips a packet-rate limiter.

modules.name: Econ Gui Overload
modules.description: Storms a shop's economy command + GUI clicks together to overload the plugin's DB/scheduler/PlaceholderAPI on the main thread. Non-op degradation vector.

modules.name: Scheduler Soak
modules.description: Sustains a command at a sub-limiter rate over a long window and reports TPS DRIFT. Tests slow, hard-to-detect degradation (task/cache/pool accumulation).

modules.name: Server Health Monitor
modules.description: Passively estimates server TPS (from time-update cadence) and ping. Measurement source for soak tests.

modules.name: Soak Test
modules.description: Runs a load module for a fixed window and asserts server TPS/ping/connection held. Resilience regression harness.

modules.name: Server Probe
modules.description: Read-only diagnostic: TPS, ping, setbacks/sec, packet rates, last kick reason. Watch how the server responds.

modules.name: Platform Probe
modules.description: Captures the server brand and classifies the platform (Paper/Spigot/Folia/Purpur/...). Context for every other audit result.

modules.name: Plugin Message Probe
modules.description: Sends BungeeCord/Velocity plugin messages (Connect/ConnectOther/Forward/PlayerCount/GetServers/IP/KickPlayer/Message/malformed) and channel register spam. Tests proxy plugin-message trust (incl. cross-player hijack).

modules.name: Cookie Probe
modules.description: Sends forged/oversized cookie responses (1.20.5+ proxy cookie system). Tests whether the server/proxy trusts unrequested cookie data.

modules.name: Packet Limiter Map
modules.description: Ramps one packet type's rate until Paper's packet-limiter throttles/kicks, reporting the threshold. Maps the limiter instead of just hitting it.

modules.name: Command Fingerprint
modules.description: Enumerates installed plugins via command tab-completion (plugin-namespaced aliases). Client-side recon of what your stack discloses.

modules.name: Folia Cross Region
modules.description: Fires actions on chunk/region boundaries to trigger Folia cross-region thread races (move/entity/block). Correlate the count with Folia logs.

modules.name: Combo Orchestrator
modules.description: Runs 3+ vectors simultaneously with per-vector stagger and a named combo library; auto-baselines each vector alone then grades what the COMBINATION uniquely produced.

modules.name: Lag Profiler
modules.description: Ramps a packet vector's rate and reports the rate that first drops TPS below the floor. Finds the breaking point.

modules.name: Typed Blink
modules.description: Holds one packet category (e.g. movement) while sending the rest. The lagback exploit. Tests position-authority for combat.

modules.name: Packet Reorder
modules.description: Buffers movement/action packets and releases them reversed or shuffled. Tests causal-order validation.

modules.name: Confirm Desync
modules.description: Withholds teleport-confirm packets. Tests how the server handles unacknowledged setbacks/teleports.

modules.name: Metadata Flood
modules.description: Floods legal metadata packets (sprint/slot/options) that are cheap to send but costly to broadcast. Tests CPU exhaustion + backpressure.

modules.name: Check Rate Monitor
modules.description: Counts server setback packets per second, split by moving vs. still. Fingerprints AC check cadence.

modules.name: Correction Timing Monitor
modules.description: Measures round-trip time from sending movement to receiving a setback. Reports AC response latency.

modules.name: Packet Cadence Monitor
modules.description: Counts S2C packets by type and reports top-N per second. Establishes baseline server traffic patterns.

modules.name: Combat Pattern Monitor
modules.description: Logs CPS, swing-to-attack ratio and per-tick attack distribution. Establishes combat baseline for AC calibration.

modules.name: Command Rate Limit Probe
modules.description: Probes each command variant in isolation, detects which bypass rate limits. Reports BYPASSED vs. LIMITED per variant.

modules.name: Command Cooldown Race
modules.description: Fires a kit/warp/home command many times in one tick to test whether the plugin's cooldown check-and-set is atomic (claim-twice race).

modules.name: Auto Audit Runner
modules.description: End-to-end audit pipeline: graded, severity-classified findings in text/markdown/json with regression diff, crash safety and auto-rejoin. The heart of ACAudit.

modules.name: Audit Scenarios
modules.description: Named Paper-environment playbooks (econ-integrity, AC-coverage-map, stability-baseline, plugin-fingerprint, combo-matrix) that each emit a severity-classified report.

modules.name: Packet Inspector
modules.description: Live C2S/S2C packet log with filter, export, field-edit and replay, plus sequence record/replay. A packet-level audit platform. Own server only.

modules.name: Pre Flight Check
modules.description: Read-only. Reports platform, detected plugins, TPS baseline, runnable item/GUI-gated modules, a recommended test order and a runtime estimate. Run FIRST.

modules.name: Player State Anomaly
modules.description: Sends sub-tick contradictory client state (flying, held slot, hand, use-item vs slot) to find where the server's view of you is momentarily undefined.

modules.name: Entity Interact Anomaly
modules.description: Probes interaction target validation: multiple types/tick, hitting never-spawned entity ids, vehicle-move with no vehicle, interact-on-death.

modules.name: Chat Signature Fuzz
modules.description: Sends chat with a garbage signature or skewed timestamp (or chat+command same tick) to test whether the server enforces secure chat or trusts client input.

modules.name: Rate Gap Probe
modules.description: Ramps a block action's rate and reports the band between the plugin's cooldown and Paper's packet-limiter — the window an attacker acts in undetected.

modules.name: Session Anomaly
modules.description: Connection-level probes: suppress chunk acks while interacting, spam client settings, or attempt a config-phase packet in play.

modules.name: Server Tick Sync
modules.description: Delivers a click/command burst at a predicted container revision, or aligned to the estimated server tick, for winning tick-boundary and revision races.
